instruction: Extract the data from cell B20 in the supplied Excel sheet and look it up in Chrome.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting the value from cell B20 ('Loreta') in the Excel file and performing a Google search for it. Evaluator verifies that the active tab URL contains a Google search query for 'loreta'. Uses the existing is_expected_search_query metric with active_tab_info getter. Verified cell B20 contains 'Loreta' by reading the complete Excel file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies that a Google search was performed for 'loreta' (the value in cell B20)
Getter (active_tab_info) correctly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome
Metric (is_expected_search_query) correctly parses rules structure and matches the URL pattern
Regex pattern is well-formed: case-insensitive, matches Google search URLs with query parameter 'loreta'
Expected value ('Loreta') was verified by reading the actual Excel file content (per metadata)

Minor limitation: evaluator only verifies the search was conducted, not that the user actually opened Excel and read cell B20, but this is acceptable given framework constraints and the known file content
